clauses.heading: FIRST AMENDMENT TO SENIOR REVOLVER LOAN AGREEMENT
clauses.text: THIS FIRST AMENDMENT TO SENIOR REVOLVER LOAN AGREEMENT, dated effective as of March 27, 2019 (the "First Amendment"), is entered into by and among EMPIRE LOUISIANA LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the "Original Borrower" or "EL") and EMPIRE NORTH DAKOTA LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("END", together with the Original Borrower are sometimes referred to herein collectively as the "Borrower") and CROSSFIRST BANK, a Kansas state-chartered bank (the "Bank").
clauses.plain_english: This clause identifies the parties involved in the amendment to the existing loan agreement, specifically adding Empire North Dakota LLC as a co-borrower alongside Empire Louisiana LLC.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard introductory clause identifying the parties and the nature of the amendment.

clauses.heading: 1. Definitions.
clauses.text: 1. Definitions. Capitalized terms used herein and not otherwise defined shall have the meaning given in the Existing Loan Agreement. In addition, the following terms are added to Article I of the Existing Loan Agreement or amended to read as follows: "Guaranty Agreement" means that certain Amended and Restated Guaranty Agreement of even date herewith, from Guarantor, in favor of Bank, in form, scope and substance acceptable to Bank. "Revolver Commitment Amount" shall be the maximum outstanding principal amount plus Letter of Credit Exposure the Bank agrees from time to time to make available under the Revolver Commitment (initially stipulated to be equal to $9,000,000.00), subject to the QCR. "Revolver Final Maturity Date" shall mean March 27, 2021, unless otherwise extended or renewed in writing by the mutual agreement of the Borrower and the Bank. "QCR" shall have the meaning given in Section 2.13 of the Loan Agreement.
clauses.plain_english: This clause defines key terms for the amendment, including the new Revolver Commitment Amount of $9,000,000 and the maturity date of March 27, 2021.
clauses.risk_justification: The definition of 'Guaranty Agreement' as being in form and substance 'acceptable to Bank' grants the Bank unilateral discretion over the terms of the guaranty.

clauses.heading: 2. Revolver Commitment.
clauses.text: 2. Revolver Commitment. The Revolver Commitment is hereby increased and renewed to the Revolver Final Maturity Date, subject to the Revolver Commitment Amount, the Collateral Borrowing Base limitations and QCR described below. All of the Indebtedness created pursuant thereto is evidenced by that certain replacement Promissory Note (Revolver Note) dated as of March 27, 2019, from the Borrower payable to the order of the Bank in the maximum principal amount of $20,000,000.00 (subject to the Revolver Commitment Amount and the Collateral Borrowing Base). The Revolver Commitment Amount and the Collateral Borrowing Base are stipulated to be set at $9,000,000.00 as of the effective date of this First Amendment, which increase shall be in accordance with and satisfy the Collateral Borrowing Base Redeterminations under Section 4.2 of the Loan Agreement for April 2019.
clauses.plain_english: This clause increases the revolving credit commitment and sets the current borrowing base at $9,000,000.00, while noting the total facility limit is $20,000,000.00.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause establishes borrowing base limitations and commitment amounts which directly impact the Borrower's liquidity and ability to draw funds.
obligations: Borrower must adhere to Collateral Borrowing Base limitations and QCR requirements
rights: Borrower is entitled to access the revolving credit facility up to the stipulated borrowing base

clauses.heading: 2.4 Loan Origination Fee.
clauses.text:
Borrower shall pay to Bank a fully earned and non-refundable loan origination fee equal to $76,900.00 (one
hundred basis points (1.00%) on the $7,690,000.00 increase in the
Revolver Commitment Amount).
clauses.plain_english:

clauses.heading: 2.12 Payment of Fees.
clauses.text: All fees payable under Sections 2.4, 2.5, 2.6, 2.10 and 2.14 shall be paid on the dates due, in immediately available funds, US Dollars, to Bank and shall be fully earned and non-refundable under any circumstances.
clauses.plain_english: This clause mandates that all specified loan fees must be paid on time in US Dollars and are non-refundable once paid.
clauses.risk_justification: The 'non-refundable under any circumstances' language creates a financial risk for the Borrower if the loan is terminated early or if the underlying service is not provided.
obligations: Pay fees under Sections 2.4, 2.5, 2.6, 2.10 and 2.14 on the dates due in immediately available US Dollars

clauses.heading: 2.13 Quarterly Commitment Reduction (QCR).
clauses.text:
On the last day of each calendar quarter, commencing June 30, 2019, the Revolver Commitment
Amount shall automatically be reduced by $150,000.00 per quarter (the
"QCR"), and Borrower shall make any principal payment necessary to
comply with the QCR. Such principal payment shall be in addition to the
regularly scheduled interest payment.
The definition of "MCR" and all references to "MCR" in the Existing Loan Agreement are
hereby deleted.

clauses.heading: 2.14 Loan Amendment Fee.
clauses.text: For each amendment or other change to this Agreement that is required (in the sole discretion of the Bank) as a result of a change in terms or conditions requested by Borrower, Borrower shall pay Bank a fee in an amount equal to the Revolver Commitment Amount then outstanding, multiplied by twenty five basis points (0.25%), which fee shall be payable in immediately available funds concurrent with the closing of such amendment.
clauses.plain_english: If the Borrower requests a change to the loan agreement, the Bank may charge a fee equal to 0.25% of the total outstanding Revolver Commitment Amount, payable at the time of the amendment.
clauses.risk_justification: The fee is calculated based on the total commitment rather than the incremental change, and the Bank has sole discretion to determine if an amendment requires a fee, creating potential for one-sided costs.
obligations: Borrower shall pay Bank a fee in an amount equal to the Revolver Commitment Amount then outstanding, multiplied by twenty five basis points (0.25%)
rights: Bank has the right to determine if an amendment requires a fee
deadlines: payable in immediately available funds concurrent with the closing of such amendment

clauses.heading: 7. Financial Statements and Reports.
clauses.text: Section 6.6(a) and the first sentence of 6.6(b) of the Existing Loan Agreement are hereby modified to provide that the Guarantor will furnish such Financial Statements and Reports pursuant to the terms of the Guaranty Agreement.
clauses.plain_english: The requirements for the Guarantor to provide financial statements are updated to align with the specific terms outlined in the separate Guaranty Agreement.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard administrative modification to align reporting requirements with an existing ancillary agreement.
obligations: Guarantor will furnish such Financial Statements and Reports pursuant to the terms of the Guaranty Agreement

clauses.heading: 8. Net Lease Operating Reports.
clauses.text: 8. Net Lease Operating Reports. The following replaces Section 6.6(c) of the Existing Loan Agreement in its entirety: (c) Net Lease Operating Reports. No later than sixty (60) days after the end of each calendar quarter, reports regarding leases in the same form as they are received by the operator under each applicable operators agreement.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower is required to submit reports regarding leases within 60 days after the end of each calendar quarter, using the same format provided by the operator.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard reporting requirement common in commercial loan agreements to ensure lender visibility into collateral performance.
obligations: Submit reports regarding leases no later than sixty (60) days after the end of each calendar quarter
deadlines: No later than sixty (60) days after the end of each calendar quarter

clauses.heading: Section 28 (Minimum Leverage Ratio) and Section 29 (Minimum Interest Coverage Ratio)
clauses.text: Section 28 (Minimum Leverage Ratio) and Section 29 (Minimum Interest Coverage Ratio) of the Existing Loan Agreement shall be measured for Borrower on a combined basis using consolidated financial statements provided by the Guarantor.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower's financial covenants regarding leverage and interest coverage will be calculated using the combined consolidated financial statements of the Guarantor.
clauses.risk_justification: Measuring covenants on a combined basis with a Guarantor can create dependency on the Guarantor's financial health and reporting accuracy, which may impact the Borrower's compliance status.

clauses.heading: 10. Collateral/Mortgages.
clauses.text: The term "Collateral" as that term is defined in Article III of the Existing Loan Agreement shall incorporate and include, without limitation, all real and personal property lien interests granted by END to Bank by the following: (i) mortgage liens or deeds of trust (as applicable) encumbering END's proved producing and proved non-producing oil, gas and other leasehold and mineral interests (including, without limitation, behind-the pipe values), on a first priority basis, including without limitation, those properties situated in the States of North Dakota and Montana (the "END Mortgages"), and (ii) a first priority security interest in substantially all of END's personal property according to the terms of a certain Pledge, Security Agreement and Assignment instrument dated as even date with this First Amendment, in form and substance satisfactory to Bank (the "END Security Agreement"). The term "Mortgages" as that term is defined in Article III of the Existing Loan Agreement shall incorporate and include the END Mortgages.
clauses.plain_english: This clause expands the definition of collateral to include specific oil, gas, and mineral interests in North Dakota and Montana, as well as a security interest in all personal property of EMPIRE NORTH DAKOTA LLC, to secure the loan.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause grants a first-priority security interest in substantially all of the borrower's assets, which creates significant exposure and limits the borrower's ability to pledge these assets elsewhere.
obligations: Grant first priority mortgage liens on oil, gas and mineral interests in North Dakota and Montana
Grant first priority security interest in substantially all personal property

clauses.heading: 12. Conditions Precedent.
clauses.text: 12. Conditions Precedent. The Borrower shall execute and deliver, or cause to be executed and delivered, to the Bank, each of the following as express conditions precedent to the effectiveness of the amendments and modifications contemplated by this First Amendment: (a) This First Amendment; (b) The replacement Promissory Note (Revolver Note); (c) The END Mortgages; (d) The END Security Agreements; (e) The Amended Louisiana Mortgage; (f) The Guaranty Agreement; (g) The obligation of Borrower to furnish the Bank with appropriate certificates from the State of North Dakota that demonstrate END is registered and qualified to do business in the State of North Dakota, shall be an express condition subsequent and must be accomplished by Borrower to the Bank's satisfaction no later than April 12, 2019, and failure of Borrower to timely satisfy such condition subsequent shall constitute an Event of Default hereunder without further or other notice from the Bank. (h) Payment to the Bank of the fully earned and non-refundable one percent (1.0%) loan origination fee in the amount of $76,900.00 concurrently herewith in immediately available funds (US Dollars); and (i) Closing certificates from each of the Borrowers.
clauses.plain_english: This clause lists the specific documents, payments, and certifications the Borrower must provide to the Bank for the amendment to become effective, including a specific deadline for North Dakota business registration that triggers an automatic default if missed.
clauses.risk_justification: The clause includes an immediate default trigger for failure to satisfy a condition subsequent (North Dakota registration) without a cure period, which creates significant risk of accelerated default.

clauses.heading: 14. Ratification.
clauses.text: The remaining terms, provisions and conditions set forth in the Existing Loan Agreement shall remain in full force and effect as long as any Indebtedness of the Borrower is owing to the Bank and/or the Revolver Commitment remains in effect. The Borrower adopts, restates, confirms and ratifies the warranties, covenants and representations set forth in the Existing Loan Agreement (except the representations and warranties that specify a specific date or period of time) and further represents to the Bank that, as of the date hereof, no Default or Event of Default exists under the Loan Agreement (including this First Amendment). All references to the "Loan Agreement" appearing in any of the Loan Documents shall hereafter be deemed references to the Existing Loan Agreement as amended, modified and supplemented by this First Amendment.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower confirms that the original loan agreement remains valid and in effect, and certifies that no default currently exists under the agreement as amended.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard ratification clause confirming the continued validity of the underlying loan agreement and the absence of current defaults.
obligations: Borrower must adopt, restate, confirm and ratify warranties, covenants and representations set forth in the Existing Loan Agreement

clauses.heading: 15. SUBMISSION TO JURISDICTION. BORROWER AND THE BANK HEREBY
clauses.text: CONSENT TO THE JURISDICTION OF ANY OF THE LOCAL, STATE, AND FEDERAL COURTS LOCATED WITHIN TULSA COUNTY, OKLAHOMA AND WAIVES ANY OBJECTION WHICH THE BORROWER MAY HAVE BASED ON IMPROPER VENUE OR FORUM NON CONVENIENS TO THE CONDUCT OF ANY PROCEEDING IN ANY SUCH COURT.
clauses.plain_english: The parties agree that any legal disputes will be handled exclusively in courts located in Tulsa County, Oklahoma, and the Borrower gives up the right to challenge this location as inconvenient or improper.
clauses.risk_justification: Submission to a specific out-of-state jurisdiction can increase legal defense costs and procedural burdens for the Borrower if they are not based in that location.
obligations: Consent to jurisdiction in Tulsa County, Oklahoma
Waive objections based on improper venue or forum non conveniens

clauses.heading: 16. WAIVER OF JURY TRIAL. BORROWER FULLY, VOLUNTARILY AND
clauses.text: EXPRESSLY WAIVES ANY RIGHT TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION OR PROCEEDING TO ENFORCE OR DEFEND ANY RIGHTS UNDER THE LOAN AGREEMENT (INCLUDING THIS FIRST AMENDMENT), THE SECURITY INSTRUMENTS OR UNDER ANY AMENDMENT, SUPPLEMENT, INSTRUMENT, DOCUMENT OR AGREEMENT DELIVERED (OR WHICH MAY IN THE FUTURE BE DELIVERED) IN CONNECTION HEREWITH OR ARISING FROM ANY BANKING RELATIONSHIP EXISTING IN CONNECTION WITH THIS AGREEMENT. THE BORROWER AGREES THAT ANY SUCH ACTION OR PROCEEDING SHALL BE TRIED BEFORE A COURT AND NOT BEFORE A JURY.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower agrees to give up their right to a jury trial for any legal disputes related to the loan, meaning any case will be decided by a judge alone.
clauses.risk_justification: Waiver of jury trial is a standard commercial practice but represents a significant surrender of a fundamental legal right to have disputes heard by a jury of peers.
obligations: Waive right to a trial by jury
Agree to have actions tried before a court

clauses.heading: 17. Governing Law.
clauses.text: 17. Governing Law. The Loan Agreement (including the First Amendment) shall be deemed to have been made or incurred under the Laws of the State of Oklahoma and shall be construed and enforced in accordance with and governed by the Laws of Oklahoma.
clauses.plain_english: This clause establishes that the laws of the State of Oklahoma will govern the interpretation and enforcement of the Loan Agreement and the First Amendment.
clauses.risk_justification: Submission to a specific state jurisdiction may increase defense costs and procedural burdens for parties located outside of Oklahoma.

clauses.heading: 18. Release.
clauses.text: 18. Release. In consideration of the amendments contained herein, Borrower hereby waives and releases Bank from any and all claims and defenses, known or unknown, as of the effective date of this First Amendment, with respect to the Loan Agreement (including this First Amendment) and the Loan Documents and the transactions contemplated thereby.
clauses.plain_english: The Borrower agrees to give up any legal claims or defenses it may have against the Bank regarding the loan relationship up to the date of this amendment.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a broad release of claims, including unknown claims, which significantly limits the Borrower's ability to seek legal remedies against the Bank for past actions.
rights: Bank is released from claims and defenses

clauses.heading: 19. Counterparts.
clauses.text: 19. Counterparts. This First Amendment may be executed in multiple counterparts, each of which, when so executed, shall constitute an original copy. Transmission by facsimile or electronic transmission (e.g., pdf format) of an executed counterpart of this First Amendment by any party shall be deemed to constitute due and sufficient delivery of such counterpart and such facsimile or electronic transmission shall be deemed to be an original counterpart of this First Amendment.
clauses.plain_english: This clause allows the parties to sign separate copies of the amendment, which together count as one original document, and accepts electronic or faxed signatures as valid delivery.
clauses.risk_justification: This is a standard boilerplate provision for contract execution that does not impose significant risk.
rights: Right to execute via multiple counterparts
Right to deliver via electronic transmission

clauses.text: 20. Reaffirmation of Indebtedness. Borrower acknowledges the terms of this First Amendment and ratifies and affirms its obligations under, and acknowledges, renews and extends its continued liability under, each Loan Document to which it is a party, and agrees that each Loan Document to which it is a party remains in full force and effect.

clauses.risk_justification: This clause reaffirms all prior obligations, which may include unknown or legacy liabilities, though it is standard in amendment agreements.
obligations: Ratify and affirm obligations under each Loan Document

summary.executive_summary: This First Amendment to the Senior Revolver Loan Agreement, effective March 27, 2019, modifies the existing credit facility between Empire Louisiana LLC, Empire North Dakota LLC, and CrossFirst Bank. The amendment increases the Revolver Commitment, establishes a Quarterly Commitment Reduction (QCR) schedule, and introduces new fees including a loan origination fee and a potential amendment fee. It further expands the collateral pool to include real and personal property interests in North Dakota and Montana and mandates strict compliance with financial reporting and conditions precedent. The agreement reaffirms all prior obligations while incorporating new jurisdictional and waiver provisions under Oklahoma law.
key_points: Increase and renewal of the Revolver Commitment subject to QCR and borrowing base limitations.
Payment of a $76,900.00 loan origination fee (1.00% of the increase).
Implementation of a $150,000.00 quarterly principal reduction (QCR) starting June 30, 2019.
Expansion of collateral to include real and personal property interests in North Dakota and Montana.
Requirement for the Guarantor to furnish financial statements and reports per the Guaranty Agreement.
Borrower's waiver of jury trial and consent to exclusive jurisdiction in Tulsa County, Oklahoma.
Broad release of claims and defenses by the Borrower in favor of the Bank.
red_flags: Broad release of all claims and defenses (known or unknown) by the Borrower against the Bank (Clause 20).
Requirement for the Borrower to pay an amendment fee at the Bank's sole discretion (Clause 7).
High-risk collateral expansion including all real and personal property interests (Clause 11).
Strict conditions precedent that, if not met, could trigger default or prevent the effectiveness of the amendment (Clause 13).
favorable_clauses: Clause 21 (Counterparts) allows for flexible execution via electronic transmission, reducing administrative burden.
Clause 15 (Ratification) provides clarity that existing terms remain in effect unless specifically modified, maintaining continuity of the original agreement.
unusual_clauses: Clause 7 (Loan Amendment Fee) grants the Bank sole discretion to charge a fee based on the outstanding commitment amount for any future changes requested by the Borrower.
Clause 20 (Release) is an exceptionally broad waiver of all potential claims and defenses, which is highly favorable to the Bank and restrictive for the Borrower.
recommended_actions: Verify the accuracy of the $76,900.00 origination fee calculation against the actual increase in the Revolver Commitment.
Confirm that the Borrower has the operational capacity to meet the QCR payment schedule starting June 30, 2019.
Review the scope of the 'Release' clause with legal counsel to assess potential impact on any existing or future disputes with the Bank.
Ensure all conditions precedent listed in Clause 13 are documented and tracked for completion by the April 12, 2019 deadline.
Evaluate the financial impact of the discretionary amendment fee provision and consider negotiating a cap or objective criteria for such fees.
